subject: Welcome to AIWA, your account is live
preheader: You have {{credits}} credits. Describe what you want and hit enter.
heroAlt: A live AIWA site on a phone, in front of a daytime mountain lake

blocks.html: Your account is live. You have {{credits}} credits to spend. Each credit lets you take a plain-English prompt and turn it into a working full-stack app: designed frontend, working backend, its own database, sign in, and one-click publishing to a live URL.
No setup. No config files. Just describe what you want and hit enter.
